title: Zach Charbonnet will not play for Seahawks on Sunday

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Zach Charbonnet will not play for Seahawks on Sunday
sources.description: Kenneth Walker will be back on the field in Seattle on Sunday for the first time since leaving the Seahawks for the Chiefs as a free agent, but Zach Charbonnet won't be joining his former teammate as an active participant.
